notes.title: Update on the Development of Kokopa's Atlas: A Message from Junie
notes.content:
Greetings Kokopa's Atlas community,

I wanted to take a moment to update you on the status of the game's development. Unfortunately, we have hit unexpected obstacles that have caused a delay in the project. I want to reassure you that we are not giving up on the game. Instead, we are taking a pause in development to focus on making important internal improvements that will result in the best gaming experience possible. 
Additionally, I wanted to let you know that Aesthetican Labs, who has been shepherding the product and community since last Spring, is no longer working on the project. We thank them for their excellent work and wish them well in their future endeavors. We want to let you know that we are still fully dedicated to making Kokopa's Atlas the game you've been waiting for, and our team is working hard to ensure that the final product will exceed your expectations.

I want to address that the delay has not yet been announced on Kickstarter, but we intend to do so as soon as we fix some technical issues with our account settings. Please bear with us as we work to resolve these issues.

Your patience and support mean everything to us, and we appreciate your understanding during this time. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on the [url=https://discord.gg/hitcents]Hitcents Discord server.[/url]

Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned for future updates.

Best regards,

Junie (Dasher)

notes.title: Time to Reflect ❤️
notes.content:
Happy new year, Atlasers! 🥳

Our team took a couple weeks off for the holidays between the last update and now. The break was very much needed, but we’re also excited to be back to work now that it’s over!

In addition to the break’s impact on our schedule, we’re also taking a quick pause from normal development work to check in with where the project is headed. 

Ever since re-evaluating our timeline in October we’ve been working towards the big goal we mentioned in December so that we could evaluate our progress after the goal was met. 

As such, this month is all about taking a step back to evaluate where we're at, reevaluate the project timeline, and plan for the future.

I’m sure it’s not thrilling to read about following the plan and doing project evaluation, and the lack of silly Pollimero gifs is a bummer all around… but this sort of check-in is really important to the success of any major project! Without it, you may get to the end of the project feeling confused about how you got there. Or you realize the game isn’t any fun/exciting/etc., but it’s too late to fix it.

We really appreciate your patience while there’s not much to post. We know you’re waiting for news, and we’ll have more detail for you in February. 

Until then, have a great start to 2023! Talk soon! 👋

notes.title: A Happy Holiday Update! ❄️
notes.content:
Hey there, Atlasers! 😄

With the holidays rapidly approaching, it sure is a chaotic time of year! Here’s what we can share about what we’ve been up to since November’s update: 

Probably the most exciting thing: we’ve added side quests! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OCo7BGg.png[/img]

On top of the main quest line (which we talked a bit about in November), there will now be side quests from the other folks you meet. This could include getting them things from the nearby forest, doing a bit of gardening for them, and more! 

Specifically, in implementing side quests, we ran into a few major development issues that slowed us down. So we spent quite a bit of time trying to iron those out (and it’s still not quite over!). 

We’ve also made some performance improvements. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JyAY5VR.png[/img]

The newest biome, the forest, has foliage that’s a lot more dense than the grasslands… and we needed to do some optimization so the game would run smoothly with so many objects in the world. 

Aside from those, it’s largely been about bug hunting! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cx8A0uf.png[/img]

[i]We call this style... chin glasses![/i]

The end of the year is a busy time and many teams have deadlines to meet before the holidays… we’re no different in that regard. We’ve got goals to meet, and part of those goals means polishing as many rough edges as we can before we set things aside for the year. Perhaps not as exciting to read about, but SO important to how the game feels. 

Things will be pretty quiet around the [url=https://discord.gg/kokopa]Kokopa’s Atlas Discord[/url] over the holidays, more than likely, but you’re always welcome to join! And it’d be giving our team a real gift if you [url=http://bit.ly/KASteam]wishlist the game on Steam[/url] (presuming you haven’t already). 

From all the folks working on Kokopa’s: we’re wishing you and your loved ones a wonderful holiday season, however you celebrate! ❄️🎁

See you in January! 👋

notes.title: The November News from Erda 9000!
notes.content:
Hey there, explorers! 

If you caught our October update, you’ll know that we ran into some issues with our timeline and had to spend some time reassessing the plan. But we’ve still been hard at work, and have some exciting improvements to share! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/w0rL8dU.png[/img]

For starters, we’ve made it easier to navigate the world thanks to more waypoints on your map for things like towns you’ve discovered and active quests. Making what already exists in the game *feel good* is one of our primary goals right now, and this is an important piece of feedback we got from the first demo.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U7JQ6JP.gif[/img]

We also made a major overhaul to the mob spawner that fixed a major issue where mobs like the “danger mushroom” would spawn on top of each other and/or WAY too often, as well as cause performance issues. Mobs now also spawn in more natural locations, like around trees! Again, this just makes the world feel more enjoyable to spend time in and easier to navigate. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yt03tZj.png[/img]

We're also working on new quests! The Wholesome Direct demo gave you only a hint of the story, and we want the intro quests to demonstrate all the new systems that have been added to the game. That means quests that utilize terraforming and gardening, for example. They’re still only meant to give you a taste of what’s to come, but a bigger and better taste than before! 

And last but certainly not least: our audio folks, Tadej and Niki, have been hard at work on [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lf8yY38Ye4_8Sa_0IQtrIzsvzCkn9o7J/view?usp=sharing]sound effects and AMAZING music[/url]. Each biome will feature a unique day and night track, as well as change and react to things like nearby mobs or villages. We can’t wait for you to hear how the world is coming along! 

The [url=https://discord.gg/kokopa]Kokopa’s Atlas Discord[/url] is the best place to reach us if you have any questions or want to chat with the community! And of course, be sure to [url=http://bit.ly/KASteam]wishlist the game on Steam[/url] if you haven’t already. It’s a huge help to the team, if you do.

See you in December! 👋

notes.title: Happy Halloween!
notes.content:
Trick or treat, Atlasers! 👻

We knew the day would probably come, eventually, as it does for nearly all gamedev projects… we’ve hit a bit of a speedbump with development, and had to spend some time reassessing our schedule and plan moving forward. 

In short, when we laid out our development plan at the start of the year, we chose to focus on getting in lots of mechanics and features up front; we put content off until later. But that has led to some mechanics not feeling well integrated with one another, and a misestimation as to how long content development would take when we got here, among other things.

So our first step in remedying some of these problems is to take some time to make sure that the mechanics that are already in (like farming, terraforming, etc.) feel good and make a cohesive, fun experience before we add any more new features. 

To be clear, everything is okay right now! But it does mean we don’t have a lot of development progress to show off this month.

The dust still hasn’t quite settled, and likely won’t until into the new year, so we can’t elaborate too much on the schedule quite yet. Of course, we’ll be sure to update you as things come into clarity. 

One thing we can show off is Kokopa & Pollimero’s INCREDIBLE Halloween costumes! 🎃🐈‍⬛

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3LF8jgb.png[/img]

Because things are up in the air, we’d love to hear from you either here or in the [url=https://discord.gg/kokopa]Kokopa’s Atlas Discord[/url]: What are you most excited about in Kokopa’s? Is there something you really wish we’d incorporate? Of course, we can’t make any promises that they’ll be added, but hearing from you all about what you want the game to be is really important to us! 

And of course, be sure to [url=http://bit.ly/KASteam]wishlist the game on Steam[/url] if you haven’t already! It helps the team so much, and we really appreciate it.

Until next time! 👋

notes.title: New Features and Switching It Up!
notes.content:
Hey there Atlasers! 😊

Oh boy, do we have a lot to talk about this month. Without further ado…

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uVhiviG.gif[/img]

([url=https://i.imgur.com/LpaVBfq.mp4]View a higher resolution version of the gif[/url])

We’ve added one of the last few outstanding features of Raf’s original demo: crafting! This gif shows Kokopa crafting a crystal core out of a gravity crystal, then adding that core to a pair of boots to make gravity boots. I wonder what else Kokopa and Pollimero might be able to craft with the resources on this new world??

And once you’ve made those impressive gravity boots, you’ve gotta put them on! Which brings us to the reworked inventory screen and selfie-mode. This is where you’ll interact with all the things you’re carrying, as well as change Kokopa’s outfit & equipment. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NME3HGH.png[/img]

A small but vibrant addition in the past month is the moon! 🌙 

Not much more to say about that… it’s the moon!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2WuC5Ui.gif[/img]

And, drumroll please… we’ve gotten the game up and running on the Switch! There’s still a lot of improvements to be made to the game’s performance and it might not run for very long… but it runs and that’s a success!

Plus, as the cherry on top for September, we're up and running with our composer and sound designer [url=https://www.tadejsupukovic.com/]Tadej Supukovic[/url] for audio for the game! We aren’t quite ready to show off anything just yet, but progress behind the scenes is really exciting, and we’ll be able to share more soon. 🎶

We’re always around on the [url=https://discord.gg/kokopa]Kokopa’s Atlas Discord[/url], which you can (& should!) [url=https://discord.gg/kokopa]join here[/url]. 

And last but not least, be sure to [url=http://bit.ly/KASteam]wishlist the game on Steam[/url] if you haven’t already! It helps more both the game and us, the team, more than you might think. If you wishlist now, or already have, thank you SO much! 

See you next month for another update! 👋

notes.title: Swimming, Clothes, and Combat Improvements!
notes.content:
Hi Explorers! 😄

We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes since our last update! Here’s what we’ve got to show you this month: 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ajWV9U6.gif[/img]

If you played this year's Wholesome Direct demo, you might have noticed that you couldn’t swim (especially if you ran into the bug that spawns you on an island, sorry about that!). So, what better way to celebrate the end of summer in the northern hemisphere than by adding swimming?! 

With this new feature, rivers will be easier to cross and islands will be accessible in your future adventures!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rsMIMmr.gif[/img]

These folks are so excited that clothes & more robust NPC generation are in! 

We've expanded the parameters for NPC generation from name and face to clothes and temperament, so the cast of characters you’ll encounter has grown exponentially!

And both the NPCs and Kokopa can show off their style with equippable clothing items now. This is just the first pass at the clothing feature. There's more clothing and styles to come in the future! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7UOJMlx.png[/img]

Speaking of change, we’ve improved the way you use some abilities by adding an ability wheel to the Atom Scraper. For now we've got terraforming and tilling soil on the wheel, with more to be added in the future!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1VR0UJI.gif[/img]

And last but certainly not least: we’ve improved combat! We got a lot of great feedback during the Wholesome Direct demo, and we've taken it to heart. We added a damage flash to Kokopa so you can more clearly see when he gets hit, your foes get knocked back when you hit them, and we added some more visual effects to improve the feeling of combat overall. Thanks for helping us improve the game!


If you don’t want to wait until mid-September to hear from us, or if you want to hang out with other Atlasers, you should [url=https://discord.gg/kokopa]join our Discord[/url]!

Also, be sure to [url=http://bit.ly/KASteam]wishlist the game[/url] if you haven't already! Wishlisting will help us reach the largest audience possible when it comes out, so it's a great way to support the development further.

Chat soon! 👋

notes.title: Grow and shape your world!
notes.content:
Long time no chat, Atlasers! 

First and foremost, thank you SO MUCH to everyone who played and gave feedback on the demo we released during Wholesome Direct! It’s so helpful for us to get your perspectives on how the game is progressing. 

Of course, we’ve got updates about how development is coming along!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iFjaWNL.gif[/img]

We know a lot of folks have been excited about farming in Kokopa’s Atlas, and we’re thrilled to say it’s finally coming together! Much like the original demo, you can extract seeds from plants and berries, till the ground, then plant those seeds and watch them grow! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RUKHL9c.gif[/img]

Of course, your plants will need time to grow. So along with integrating time into the world, comes a beautiful day/night cycle and updated skybox. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xO2ZWpb.gif[/img]

And very much related to farming comes terraforming! Grow and shape your world as you see fit! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xsfbIYu.gif[stealth gif][/img]

We've also added something integral to a game with optional combat—stealth! Now you can try to sneak up on, or past, any mobs you encounter. 

Though we’ll continue to post regular updates, if you're hungry to stay even more up to date with us and with other KA fans, [url=https://discord.gg/kokopa]our Discord[/url] is the place to be.

Until next time! 👋

notes.title: Wholesome Direct and a new demo!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0Eg0chN.gif[/img]

📣 Calling all Atlasers! 📣

Today is the day! Well, June 11th was technically the day. But today is still a day! As you might be aware, we launched a new public demo during the [url=https://wholesomegames.com/]Wholesome Direct[/url] this weekend. Thanks to everyone who tuned in and checked out the demo over the weekend. We've been super hard at work over here at AeLa HQ for the past months and we're excited to be finally sharing this demo with you all.

With this new demo, you can expect to see some exciting new things including:
Completely overhauled controller for buttery smooth exploration
Procedurally generated world (including villages and NPCs!) and a world map
New NPCs to meet and villages to see
A new desert biome with a new enemy you'll definitely be seeing more of in the future

There's still a long way to go from here, but we hope this will give you an idea of our plans for the future.

[url=http://bit.ly/KokopaDemo]Click here to get the new demo![/url]

We'd love to hear your feedback on the demo! Please fill out the in-game form using F12 to send us bug reports and feedback. You can also join the conversation on the [url=https://discord.gg/kokopa]Kokopa's Atlas Discord[/url], where we'll be around to chat.

Talk later! 👋

notes.title: Demo info and other cool new updates!
notes.content:
Howdy Adventurers!

It's been a very busy month for us over at AeLa HQ as we continue full steam ahead towards next month's demo. Speaking of: we're happy to announce that [b]Kokopa's Atlas will be featured in the next [url=https://linktr.ee/wholesomegames]Wholesome Direct[/url] on June 11th[/b]. Be sure to check out the direct for a special announcement. 😉

As previously noted, we're overhauling big core parts of the game to hopefully make long-term development smoother. Recently we've also been able to start on some of the more unique features that will support our vision for the game. Here's what we've got to show you this month:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7mdGBzl.gif[/img]

If you've been following the updates so far, you might be aware that we added jumping to Kokopa's abilities recently. Just like in the original demo though, if a ledge is too high for Kokopa's jump, he can try to climb up!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/C9fVve8.gif[/img]

Of course, what's a good adventure without some action rolls? Kokopa can roll on demand or automatically to soften hard landings.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6om0eCi.gif[/img]

As we continue to flesh out the new procedurally generated world, we've added more NPCs and randomly generated villages for them to live in! In your adventures, you'll find many different villages that are home to a variety of villagers with different jobs, preferences, and temperaments. 

We're now working on the quests and story for the upcoming demo, as well as ironing out bugs and smoothing the rough edges as best we can before the demo launch. The narrative in the upcoming demo will be similar to the original demo, but with some new and exciting twists that will hopefully get y'all thinking about where this story may be going. I'd tell you more, but I don't want to spoil anything! 🤫

As usual you're welcome to join us in the [url=https://discord.gg/kokopa]Kokopa's Atlas Discord[/url] to keep up to date between these posts and to chat with the community!

See you soon! 👋

notes.title: Dev Log: Procedurally Generated Worlds & Improved Mechanics
notes.content:
Hey Polli Pack!

It's been a really wild month-or-so for Kokopa's Atlas! As we mentioned in the last post, April was the first month of full-time development on KA for us here at AeLa. We've been continuing to rework core parts of the game from the ground up and we've got a few cool updates to show for it. 

Before I dig into that though I've got some housekeeping: from now on we'll be posting these updates both on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hypermegapixel/kokopas-atlas-discover-new-beginnings-and-grand-adventure]Kickstarter[/url] and on our Steam page (hello, Steam readers!). Feel free to follow along either here or there. It doesn't make much of a difference to us! 😄

Let's get to the good stuff!

On top of the improvements we've been hard at work on, we're adding some new elements to the world including [b]new resources to collect and new ways to collect them![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40714570/1f2e16d8372bed832abb3557619db96aaa3079c2.gif[/img]
[i]I wonder what resources Kokopa will be able to mine and what they could be used for…[/i]

Since our last update we've also been wrapping up our work on the improved Kokopa controller, including (drumroll please…)

Jumping!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40714570/785b05fa292aab5795a3114987a9e0e78b7bb786.gif[/img]

Our vision for Kokopa's Atlas focuses heavily on exploration and adventure, and we want that exploration to be smooth and seamless whether you want to take it fast or slow. For those of you who've played the original demo, we also fixed that occasional bug where Kokopa falls through the ground. 😅

Speaking of exploration, we've been retooling some of the navigation systems including the scanner, compass bar, and a [b]new world map[/b] to help you get your bearings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40714570/1a9d9171978fc406788e1cd4d96ad72e77d12759.gif[/img]

OH! That reminds me of another exciting development! We're happy to announce that the next demo will include a [b]fully procedurally generated world![/b] In June, each of you will have your own unique world to get lost in.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z6kOzjR.gif[/img]

You might notice some of your favorite flora and fauna missing in this new world. Please bear with us as we get the generated world up to speed with the level of detail of the original demo. We promise it will be worth the wait!

Throughout the month we've been posting lil updates, bugs, and other treats over in the Kokopa's Atlas [url=https://discord.com/invite/vNGXVkN]Discord[/url]! If you haven't already joined, please hop in and join the community! It's a great chance to get in touch with us and get real time updates on your favorite adventure cat and bio-birb.

See you next month! 👋
